zh-CN.name: 转化优化型
zh-CN.description: 围绕一个明确的转化目标组织信息、操作与反馈，例如完成注册或开始试用。是否优化有效需结合用户任务和实际数据验证，不能仅由按钮颜色或视觉风格判断。
use_when: 有明确且对用户有价值的主要行动。
能够验证关键步骤的完成率与阻碍。
avoid_when: 不要用误导、假倒计时或默认勾选迫使用户行动。
不要把停留时间或点击量直接当作完成目标。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 确定一个对用户有价值的主行动，按决策所需信息排列页面，清楚说明成本与限制；减少重复填写和无关选择；完成后给出明确反馈，并以真实任务完成数据评估改版。

en.name: Conversion-Optimized
en.description: A page approach organized around an explicit conversion goal such as registration or starting a trial. Its effectiveness requires evidence from user tasks and actual outcomes, not assumptions based on button color or visual style.
use_when: The primary action has a clear benefit for users.
The team can evaluate completion and obstacles along the task path.
avoid_when: Avoid deceptive urgency, fake countdowns and coercive defaults.
Do not treat time on page or raw clicks as task completion.
en.prompt_template: Define one user-benefiting primary action and organize information around that decision. Explain costs and limitations, reduce duplicate entry and irrelevant choices, and give clear completion feedback. Evaluate changes using actual task outcomes.
